name: Unbeatable: The Jamie Paige Content Companion
summary:
Introducing The Jamie Paige Content Companion DLC - a full on collaborative project with hit vocal synth producer Jamie Paige! Upgrade Arcade Mode with a dose of new originals, fan-favorite tracks, playable characters, and all new challenges.

Unbeatable - The Jamie Paige Content Companion DLC includes:
Four brand new originals exclusive to Unbeatable, made in collaboration between the D-Cell Sound Team and Jamie P.

Two additional remixes with Jamie-P's "I Wish That I Could Fall" and Unbeatable's "Sleeping In", plus an exclusive cover of エビチャーハン! sung by Quaver (Holly Earl).

Plus a multitude of additional tracks, leading to a total of 12(?) songs.

Two Playable New Characters: Jamie Paige (she's real!), and Chef Quaver (she's frying some rice)

Two New Stages: The Apple Orchard (based on Birdbrain), and Wrestling Arena (based on :women_wrestling:). Plus, enjoy music video backgrounds for Birdbrain, Rot for Clout, and Machine Love!

New DLC-Exclusive Challenge Folio included with the DLC, featuring unlocks for additional Arcade Mode titles, menu palettes, end game Star charts, and...

No secrets.
